description: Enforced field set and enums for the declarative ingress (pre-model) data-minimisation gate record. Single source read by scripts/validate_ingress_sanitization.py; the prose ingress-sanitization-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (ADMITTED forbids WITHHELD units and any residual finding; WITHHELD requires a WITHHELD unit; TRANSFORMED units name a technique, a finding category, a count and a rule; the record technique list equals the techniques of its TRANSFORMED units; PSEUDONYMIZATION units state where the mapping is held but never carry it; DELEGATED_AGENT needs a delegation_ref; a SECRETS_ONLY detector needs a real limitation; NOT_ATTEMPTED/UNVERIFIABLE carry no units; no value, mapping or secret-shaped string anywhere) stay in the validator. assurance_level is DECLARED or UNVERIFIABLE, never VERIFIED: a self-describing record cannot verify itself.
